Shenzhen Hengtian Weiye Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004. Its headquarters is at the Liuxiandong headquarters base in Nanshan District, Shenzhen (owned property), and its production base is in Huiyang District, Huizhou (self-built), right next to the Pingshan New District and Longgang District of Shenzhen.

Main Business

H.C.C. INTERNATIONAL LIMITED's core business covers the full process of product development (ODM), PCB manufacturing, component sourcing, SMT placement, functional testing, and finished-product assembly, providing customers with end-to-end electronics product solutions. Whether for mass production or customized requirements, H.C.C. INTERNATIONAL LIMITED can meet them efficiently, ensuring product quality and delivery schedules.

Production Capacity and Equipment

H.C.C. INTERNATIONAL LIMITED currently operates 5 SMT lines and 4 DIP insertion lines, giving it the capacity for large-scale production. It has a range of high-end production and inspection equipment, including X-RAY, AOI (automated optical inspection), SMT placement machines (YAMAHA), SPI (solder paste inspection), wave soldering, selective wave soldering, and reflow soldering (nitrogen oven).

深圳市恒天伟业科技有限公司成立于2004年，总部位于深圳南山区留仙洞总部基地（自购），生产基地位于惠州市惠阳区（自建），紧邻深圳坪山新区与龙岗区。

主营业务

恒天伟业的核心业务包括产品研发（ODM）、PCB生产、元器件采购、SMT贴片、功能测试、成品组装等全流程服务，为客户提供全方位的电子产品解决方案。无论是批量生产还是定制化需求，恒天伟业都能高效满足，确保产品质量与交货时间。

生产能力与设备

恒天伟业目前拥有5条SMT生产线和4条DIP插件线，具备大规模生产的能力。有 X-RAY、AOI（自动光学检测）、SMT贴片机(YAMAHA)、SPI（锡膏检测）、波峰焊、选择性波峰焊以及回流焊（氮气炉）等多种高端生产设备和检测设备。
